last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Wed 10-14 midday, chat, written, engaged and stayed long. Opened with appuram named as his (phone ask landed cold this morning) + agam/puram lore (appuram = 'that side'; Sangam poetry's inner/outer baskets). He read 'Appuram enna aachu?' unaided -> 'What happened after?'. Terrace vignette (Karthi + Deepa whispering after Paati found out), page, English answers, all unaided: appo ippo enna pannradhu -> 'now what do we do' right; Paati knows ellaam right; mudinjaachu -> 'it's over' right (we're done for). Anna's question numbering was off (asked Deepa's 'second' line, he answered her third) - Anna's error, not his. aachu-as-'has become' unpacked: a) tea ready aachu right; b) 'Bus late aachu, adhaan innum varala' - late aachu + adhaan right, innum (still) and varala (-la doing its real job: hasn't come) taught; c) 'kalyanam aagi pathu varusham aachu' - kalyanam + pathu right, varusham taught (varsha = rain; years counted in monsoons). PERSONAL: Canadian wedding 2016-10-01, Coimbatore wedding 2016-10-23 - the tenth anniversary is NOW. OFFERED (not yet accepted, his to take): field op for Oct 23, 'Namma kalyanam aagi pathu varusham aachu' said to her unannounced; collect = how it felt, never evidence. SWEEP (46 words, page, check --read logged): owns pidikkaadhu, maama, ippa, aamaa aamaa, kilambu, prachanai, kilambalaamaa, paarthen, chinna, appuram paakkalaam, anju, athai, konjam medhuvaa sollunga, oru maasam iruppom, periya, valadhu pakkam thirumbunga, kitta, freeyaa vidunga, nethu, avan. Partial: innum konjam saapdunga (read saapdunga as noun 'food' - noun-for-verb in recognition), ponen ('go' - dropped the -en past), kekkuren ('heard' - took -ren present as past). Wrong, revealed with story: purinjudhu (got it), mudiyala (can't - mudi family), kadaisila paakkalaam (kadai shop vs kadaisi last), kovam (anger, not kovil temple), enga (where/our). Blanks revealed: aanaa, petti, kidaichudhu, paravaayilla, ezhundhen, bayam, kettaanga, unga, azhagaana, neram, kavalai, munnaadiye, naanga, neraa, anuppu. Tense tails (-en did / -ren doing) are the live recognition gap. AUDIO: M97 'Exact Change' (Paati's counter-move, ~3.4 min) published today, not yet heard; phone not notified. BUILD (Andrew as @build, same sitting): meedhi/appo/ellaam had no lexicon rows (10-12 close never used --teach; soak payload accepted unknown keys) - minted today via --teach. Provenance item solren='I will say' rejected on Anna's recommendation. Andrew's ruling: the learner is the wrong ear for the review seat - flagged lines fail closed, new words welcome, inventory guarded (to be built via /extend next). CARRY: 09-22 poga mudiyala/polaam/irukken written supported; 09-21 kitta irukku and aana supported written only. Receptive check never run by ear. Live slips: past-tense (recognition now too), nga-has-no-address, noun-for-verb, respect-nga, come-go-direction, default-la-tail, literary-twin. VAA stays out of chat production until unannounced ambush. NEXT: M97 by ear with no script - 'what did Paati do, who went quiet, where's the money' - meedhi/appo/ellaam/aachu family's first ear test. Different room for any chat scene. Hook: the Oct 23 line, if he wants it.

soak_order.scene_seed: Paati's counter-move: now that she knows about the sweet box and the leftover money, she quietly turns the tables on Karthi, Deepa and Mama at the table
soak_order.focus: A sit-down, enjoyable household scene that reuses this week's words cold, by ear: meedhi (the rest/leftover - meedhi panam), appo (so/then - as a reaction), ellaam (everything - Paati-ku ellaam theriyum), X-um Y-um (both/and), and the -aachu family (enna aachu, evlo aachu, mudinjaachu, late aachu). Paati is a step ahead of everyone. English scaffolding carries meaning; introduce only what the scene needs. Never target his decade-old core words (venum/venaam/podhum).
